title: Will It Teach as Intended? How Teachers Configure Educational AI Chatbots
summary: Teachers are increasingly using generative AI to support instruction, yet it remains unclear how pedagogical intentions are translated into chatbot configurations and reflected in chatbot behavior. We studied a teacher-facing chatbot authoring tool in professional development workshops with 27 middle school teachers, analyzing focus-group interviews alongside configuration and interaction logs.
